description: We are building Astro Planet - an interactive Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer where kids learn to manage a lunar and Martian outpost by balancing life support, radiation shielding, power, and food production.
summary:
MOON BASE is an interactive web game for Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer challenge.

Players must survive 30 days on Moon by balancing O2, Food, Shield (radiation), and Power. Real NASA trade-offs: solar vs nuclear power, algae vs packaged food.

Features:
- Live resource management
- STEM learning with engineering decisions
- 30-day mission timer

Team Astro Planet, Kanjirappally, Kerala
Tech: React, Tailwind
Live Demo: https://funny-klepon-fa088b.netlify.app/
Demo Video: https://youtu.be/gcKXIGzyg68?si=8ltkMQNt7agCPMJN
details:
MOON BASE - 30-Day Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer

What it does: A survival game where players manage O2, Food, Shield, Power from Day 1 to Day 30 on the Moon. Each action has cost (O2 +20 costs 30 Power). Random events: Solar Flare (Shield -30), Dust Storm (Power -40), Good Harvest (Food +20).

How it works: Loop - Check lowest resource -> Fix it -> Next Day. If any bar = 0%, mission fails.

NASA Concepts: Life Support (ISS/Artemis), Radiation Risk, Solar Power Management, Bio-regenerative Food.

Impact: Makes Moon science fun for school students. Teaches systems thinking and resource management.

Tech: HTML, CSS, JavaScript. Works on mobile + laptop.

Team Astro Planet, Kanjirappally, Kerala
